rightsReview.reason: Full current Meitetsu public-site policy reviewed, including content-data copyright, no unauthorized reproduction/adaptation/secondary use, commercial linking restrictions and disclaimer. No raw reuse license inferred. Retain only minimal independently structured station calls of six actual weekday train columns (530/531 Toyota, 593/694 Inuyama, 531/530 Komaki) inside three bounded Meitetsu operator-line sections, plus a minimal shared-station passage relation, URL/date/hash and licensed S12 identity. Current March 14 2026 timetable portal explicitly links the reviewed PDFs; their first pages were individually rendered and viewed. Do not republish numeric timetables, full compilations, prose, artwork, geometry or commercial page embeds. Opposite-direction columns independently reviewed; no reversal-only assumption or timetable passing-row admission.
